ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) clusters localized specifically at the distal tips and water splash boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of calcified barnacles forming irregular geometric extensions at both the left and right distal tips; presence of multiple circular depigmentation rings (scars) on the dark ventral surface.
